entities.title: agent-fs skill
entities.summary: SKILL.md tells a coding agent to read, search, list and outline files with afs instead of cat, sed -n, grep -r, git grep or find, and how to act on its replies.
entities.purpose: Guidance for the coding agent, loaded by name and description from its front matter (name agent-fs): which afs tools to use, the order to use them in, what unchanged markers, hunks and truncation mean, and how to build afs. AGENTS.md lists it under Skills.
boundaries: Only instructions: the tool itself is macos/rust/agent-fs, and its README holds the full field reference.
Changes follow agents/directives.md, as AGENTS.md requires for skills.
